caption: The drawing features a single, ornate candlestick positioned vertically at the center of the composition. The candlestick is rendered in shades of brown, ochre, cream, and black, with a glossy, speckled appearance suggesting a ceramic or polished stone surface. The candlestick consists of a wide, rounded base, a narrower, cylindrical stem with two horizontal ridges around its midsection, and a circular platform at the top. The candlestick sits on a flat, rectangular surface depicted in a pale turquoise blue with visible reflections, indicative of a glass or polished finish. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or details present. The shadow and reflection of the candlestick are visible on the turquoise surface below it.
title: Candlestick
